source: GitHub 官方 Trending 周榜 stars this week · 2026-11-22 页面读取 · 按数值降序
source_detail: 直接请求 https://github.com/trending?since=weekly，逐条读取 stars this week 原文数字后按数值降序重排；保存全部候选，供「按增幅」重新取前 10。

items.name: univer
items.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.

items.name: modern-web-guidance-src
items.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

items.name: last30days-skill
items.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

items.name: open-code-review
items.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

items.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready

items.name: ag-ui
items.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.

items.name: ffmpeg-skill
items.description: Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.

items.name: plannotator
items.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

items.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
